description: A diff adds a webhook notifier that consumes res.json() without checking res.ok and detaches a fire-and-forget promise with no error handler — two unhandled error paths that pass type-checks and happy-path tests. The reviewer must catch both under its quality/error-handling review, not just the style surface.

dispatch_context.task: Review this new webhook notification module added in the current branch.
dispatch_context.diff:
--- /dev/null
+++ b/fixtures/src/webhook-notify.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,14 @@
+const WEBHOOK_URL = 'https://hooks.internal/orders'
+
+export async function sendOrderWebhook(orderId: string): Promise<string> {
+  const res = await fetch(WEBHOOK_URL, {
+    method: 'POST',
+    body: JSON.stringify({ orderId }),
+  })
+  const data = await res.json()
+  return data.deliveryId
+}
+
+export function notifyOrderShipped(orderId: string): void {
+  sendOrderWebhook(orderId)
+}

rubric_hints.trigger_reliability: Agent applies its Code Quality + error-handling lens to the new module rather than only scanning naming/style; both defects live on paths no happy-path run exercises
rubric_hints.output_structure: Documented report format; each defect is a separate finding with file:line and a concrete fix (check res.ok / guard the response body before indexing; attach a logged .catch to the fire-and-forget call)
rubric_hints.non_negotiable_adherence: Flat-worker default honored (no nested verifier dispatch without 'mode: nested-verify'); the agent reviews and recommends — it does not rewrite fixtures/src/webhook-notify.ts
rubric_hints.side_effect_correctness: PRIMARY BUG CHECK: at least Critical/High coverage of the two planted error paths — (1) res.json()/data.deliveryId consumed without confirming the response succeeded, so a 500 yields a crash or garbage deliveryId; (2) notifyOrderShipped detaches the promise with no error handler, so any failure is silently swallowed. No fixture files modified
rubric_hints.error_propagation: Both unhandled paths are surfaced as prioritized findings; reporting only one and skipping its sibling, or demoting silent-failure to a Low style note, is the failure mode under test
